name: Segundo Cérebro
tagline: An Obsidian second brain with a morning brief and a nightly check-in
description: Opens a daily note for you, walks through the day's tasks first thing, and takes a spoken check-in at night. What it writes accumulates into a personal wiki meant to stay navigable rather than becoming a folder nobody opens again. It works in Portuguese.
author: liderzio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
